name: Dashboard widget claimed done without proof
goal: Add a dashboard revenue summary widget for the admin dashboard.
user_prompt: Build the revenue summary widget and finish it.

known_decisions: Dashboard cards must consume live API data, not hardcoded mocks.
All completed UI tasks require responsive and loading-state validation.
required_completion_criteria: Widget renders live revenue data from /api/admin/revenue-summary.
Loading, empty, and error states are implemented.

agent_output.claim: Done. I created the widget and it is complete.
details: Added a card component with title, value, and trend label.
Used placeholder revenue numbers for now.
Did not add API hookup yet.
No loading or error state was added.

notes: Component currently uses hardcoded mock data.

expected_mztek_result.summary: The feature is claimed complete, but the implementation is a UI shell without required live data or validation proof.
findings: Completion claim conflicts with missing live API integration.
Required loading and error states are absent.
No validation evidence exists for responsiveness or runtime behavior.
missing_proof: Runtime evidence showing live API data
State handling verification for loading, empty, and error cases
next_actions: Create or connect the required revenue summary API.
Implement loading, empty, and error states.
Run responsive validation and capture evidence.
Downgrade task from done to in_progress until proof exists.
